WONDER DAILY GRADE 3 · WRITING

Explain a web clue in your words

Spider Webs · Curiosity day

Name __________________________ Date _______________

Choose one picture. Say your idea first, then draw or write it.

Draw an orb web. Mark the hub, one radius, and one spiral loop.

hub · radii · spiral · silk · because · maybe

The dry lines are often the radii because … what job do the spokes do?

Some silk can catch without glue because … what is woolly cribellate silk like?

Dew makes a web easier to see because … what do the beads do to light?

Does your sentence tell what you noticed and use because or maybe to explain?
